text_block_list.text:
On the way to another training session
with
Сайленс Судзука...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh, Suzukaaa! Howdy dooo? I found
you!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text: Hm?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Ka-thoomp!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Wah!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Golly, am I happy I ran into you!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
Тайки Шаттл dashes towards Silence
Suzuka and
gives her a great, big hug!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh! Sorry, pardner! ☆
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
I-it's okay. Was there... something you
needed?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Oopsie! I almost forgot! I wanna throw a
party!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text: A party?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Yessiree! My folks just sent me some big
ol' juicy
steaks!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
I say we eat it together and wash it down
with
some nice, fresh milk! Hehe! Now,
don't that
sound fun?
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
I'm grateful for the invitation, but... I'm
not really
good with big groups.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
That ain't no problem! We can have a
party with
just the two of us! You and
me!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text: Really?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Now, you know I love gatherin' a buncha
folks
round for a big party!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
But you're my special guest today! A
nice, quiet
time with you is A-OK with
me!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
So long as my guest is happy, I'm
happy! ☆
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text: Hehe, if you say so...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Taiki. Um... would one more
guest be
okay?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'm good with whoever you
wanna
invite!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
Тренер? What do you think? Do you
want to join
us?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list: We should get in a good workout before eating.

text_block_list.text:
Тренер? What do you think? Do you
want to join
us?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list: We should get in a good workout before eating.

text_block_list.text:
All right. I'm looking forward to trying a
real
American-style meal.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Yippee! I hope you're good 'n hungry!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
Cause the pile of steaks is as high as the
Rocky
Mountains!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text: ...I don't know if I can eat that much.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: All right, then! Time to get cookin'!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text: W-wait a minute! Taiki!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Yes, you're quite right.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Taiki, would you mind if I work up an
appetite
first?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Of course not! Better yet, why don't I
join you?
We're gonna be starvin' after
this!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
And whaddaya say we make it
interesting?
Winner gets to eat all the
steak they want! Buffet
style!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I don't know about a buffet, but a
race
does sound fun.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: On your marks! Get set!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text: Go!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Over the course of the party, the three
of us
somehow manage to finish every
bite of Taiki's
mountain of steaks.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After working up an appetite, both
racers regain
their stamina by devouring
plenty of steak.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
